concept: Weird 117 film: Hot Kiss comes alive (the artwork starts breathing, its surface rising and falling like the belly of a sleeping animal), then everything melts into thick glossy black tar that bubbles and swallows it all, it becomes a strange old barber who cuts the hair of the material with huge scissors, ending on 117 made of shiny wet spaghetti in tomato sauce, on a checkered tablecloth
audio_source: original synthesized sound bed generated locally with ffmpeg (noise, drones, blips); no third-party audio
